stages.name: Diagnostic and working environment
stages.objective: Establish what can be skipped and make one reproducible Python repository.

stages.name: Independent Python software
stages.objective: Build, test and explain a complete command-line data application.
stages.career: Small automation work; foundation for junior applications

modules.name: Python abstractions
modules.build: Refactor collector using dataclasses, type annotations, generators and context managers
modules.acceptance: Typed boundary validation; demonstrate generator memory behavior and two invalid-input cases

modules.name: Design and debugging
modules.build: Separate pure transformations from I/O; compare procedural, OO and functional versions; profile a slow path
modules.acceptance: Explain chosen design; locate two seeded bugs; compare before/after profile on identical input

modules.name: Release engineering
modules.build: Package the collector, add CI, changelog, documentation and a clean-environment install
modules.acceptance: One documented command processes fixtures; CI succeeds; closed-book parser task and release demo pass

stages.name: Algorithms and discrete reasoning
stages.objective: Choose algorithms using invariants and measured scaling.
stages.career: Junior coding interviews and performance literacy

modules.name: Proofs and complexity
modules.build: Write loop invariants and operation counters for linear/binary search
modules.acceptance: Prove termination and correctness; predict and measure scaling at three input sizes

modules.name: Sorting and hashing
modules.build: Implement mergesort and a collision-handling hash table
modules.acceptance: Match reference results on random/adversarial cases; explain worst-case versus expected costs

modules.name: Trees and heaps
modules.build: Implement binary search tree operations and a heap-based top-k selector
modules.acceptance: Property tests preserve ordering; handle duplicate/empty input; explain skewed-tree behavior

modules.name: Graphs
modules.build: Implement BFS, DFS, topological ordering and Dijkstra on program/prerequisite graphs
modules.acceptance: Detect cycles; compare shortest paths with tiny hand-solved examples; reject unsupported negative weights

modules.name: Dynamic programming
modules.build: Implement edit distance and one knapsack-style problem
modules.acceptance: Derive recurrence and base cases; compare memoized and tabulated versions

modules.name: Index and ranking
modules.build: Build an inverted index and ranked keyword search over program fixtures
modules.acceptance: Queries return known documents; explain tokenization and ranking; compare with linear scan

modules.name: Integration and interview
modules.build: Integrate search into collector; solve unseen array and graph tasks
modules.acceptance: All P2 tests pass; defend complexity; solve two appropriately scoped unseen tasks with explanation

stages.name: Backend engineering and data products
stages.objective: Deliver a reliable database-backed service with a repeatable deployment.

modules.name: Relational modeling
modules.build: Model schools, programs, source snapshots and provenance in SQL
modules.acceptance: Constraints reject invalid relations; migration and rollback work on fixtures

modules.name: SQL and transactions
modules.build: Implement joins, aggregates, pagination and concurrent updates
modules.acceptance: Explain transaction isolation; tests expose and prevent a lost update

modules.name: HTTP and API contracts
modules.build: Inspect a raw HTTP request locally; build typed endpoints and validation
modules.acceptance: Contract tests cover status codes, malformed inputs and pagination bounds

modules.name: Authentication and security
modules.build: Add maintained auth integration, role-based authorization and secret handling
modules.acceptance: Anonymous writes and cross-user access denied; parameterized queries resist injection fixtures

modules.name: Reliable ingestion
modules.build: Import source snapshots with idempotency, schema validation and retry budgets
modules.acceptance: Second import creates zero duplicates; malformed records quarantined with provenance

modules.name: Indexes and caching
modules.build: Profile SQL queries; add index and bounded cache with invalidation
modules.acceptance: Query plan and latency distribution recorded; stale-cache scenario tested

modules.name: Deployment and CI
modules.build: Containerize API/database; add automated tests and repeatable staging deployment
modules.acceptance: Fresh clone starts service; failed checks block release; rollback demonstrated

modules.name: Operations
modules.build: Add structured logs, health checks, metrics, backup and restore procedure
modules.acceptance: Restore into empty database; diagnose injected outage; define one user-facing SLO

modules.name: Release and job checkpoint
modules.build: Run load test, external review, architecture explanation and portfolio release
modules.acceptance: P3 contract and mastery rubric pass; record bottleneck, limits and a reviewed change

stages.name: Computer systems and concurrency
stages.objective: Understand how programs use CPUs, memory, operating systems and networks.
stages.career: Backend depth and preparation for infrastructure

modules.name: Representation and architecture
modules.build: Build small ALU simulation; inspect compiled arithmetic and cache-sensitive loops
modules.acceptance: Explain signed/unsigned overflow and cache locality using measured examples

modules.name: C and memory
modules.build: Write C array/string routines and a small owned buffer
modules.acceptance: Compiler warnings clean; memory sanitizer finds then verifies repair of bounds/lifetime bugs

modules.name: Processes and virtual memory
modules.build: Create process pipeline and inspect address-space/memory behavior
modules.acceptance: Explain fork/exec, file descriptors and virtual versus physical memory; reap child processes

modules.name: Threads and synchronization
modules.build: Build bounded producer-consumer queue with locks/conditions
modules.acceptance: Stress test for races/deadlocks; explain each shared-state invariant

modules.name: Async and parallel work
modules.build: Compare threads, processes and async fetching on local simulated I/O
modules.acceptance: Bound concurrency; measure CPU/I/O workloads; explain interpreter/runtime limits

modules.name: Networking
modules.build: Write local TCP client/server with framing, timeouts and partial-read handling
modules.acceptance: Fragmented messages reassemble; disconnect and timeout tests pass; explain DNS/TLS/HTTP roles

modules.name: Persistence and interpreters
modules.build: Build append-only record log with recovery plus tiny expression parser/evaluator
modules.acceptance: Recover valid prefix after truncated write; reject malformed expressions; explain AST and execution

modules.name: Systems integration
modules.build: Integrate worker and log with ingestion; profile and document failure modes
modules.acceptance: Kill worker mid-job and recover without duplicate committed records; P4 oral/debugging gate passes

stages.name: Mathematics and numerical experiments
stages.objective: Derive and numerically verify the mathematics needed for learning systems.
stages.career: Prerequisite for ML; diagnostic credit available

modules.name: Vectors and geometry
modules.build: Implement dot products/projections and a least-squares geometry notebook
modules.acceptance: Dimensions correct; explain span, rank, orthogonality and geometric interpretation

modules.name: Linear algebra
modules.build: Implement small elimination solver; compare QR/SVD-based library solves
modules.acceptance: Residuals reported; explain conditioning and why explicit inverse is avoided

modules.name: Calculus
modules.build: Derive scalar/vector chain rules and implement finite-difference checks
modules.acceptance: Check gradients on three functions; explain Jacobian shapes and numerical error

modules.name: Probability
modules.build: Simulate conditional events and Bayes updates; compute moments
modules.acceptance: Match analytical results within Monte Carlo uncertainty; distinguish independence/conditional independence

modules.name: Inference and experiment design
modules.build: Bootstrap a metric and simulate confidence-interval coverage
modules.acceptance: Explain sampling unit, uncertainty, multiple comparisons and why association is not causation

modules.name: Optimization
modules.build: Implement gradient descent with learning-rate and regularization experiments
modules.acceptance: Derive least-squares gradient; show convergent/divergent cases without hiding failures

modules.name: Information and numerics
modules.build: Implement stable softmax/log-sum-exp, entropy and KL on discrete distributions
modules.acceptance: Handle extreme logits; explain floating-point cancellation and KL directionality

modules.name: Math gate
modules.build: Build PCA via SVD and defend derivations plus simulation notebook
modules.acceptance: Pass five-domain diagnostic at 80% per domain; unseen gradient and probability tasks pass

stages.name: Classical machine learning and data quality
stages.objective: Build a valid experiment and deploy a model whose limitations are measurable.
stages.career: Applied ML portfolio, strongest with prior software work

modules.name: Data contracts and EDA
modules.build: Create versioned dataset, missingness report and provenance ledger
modules.acceptance: Document labels, unit of observation, allowed usage and leakage risks

modules.name: Regression from scratch
modules.build: Implement linear/ridge regression and compare to library reference
modules.acceptance: Gradient check passes; residuals and baseline metric recorded

modules.name: Classification from scratch
modules.build: Implement logistic regression with stable loss
modules.acceptance: Gradient and prediction checks pass; class imbalance and threshold trade-off explained

modules.name: Trees and ensembles
modules.build: Implement tiny decision stump then compare tree and ensemble models
modules.acceptance: Validate split logic; tuning uses only training/validation data

modules.name: Unsupervised learning
modules.build: Implement k-means and compare PCA/cluster assignments
modules.acceptance: Explain initialization sensitivity and why clusters are not ground truth

modules.name: Evaluation and features
modules.build: Build preprocessing pipeline with group/time-aware cross-validation
modules.acceptance: No test-set fitting; compare dummy, linear and tree baselines with uncertainty

modules.name: Robustness and calibration
modules.build: Evaluate subgroup errors, calibration, drift and out-of-domain behavior
modules.acceptance: Choose metric from task costs; report unsupported subgroup conclusions honestly

modules.name: Model service
modules.build: Package model and preprocessing together; add schema and drift checks
modules.acceptance: Offline/online predictions match; rollback to baseline works; artifact/data versions traceable

modules.name: ML release
modules.build: Freeze test set, run final experiment, produce model/data cards and technical defense
modules.acceptance: P6 reproducibility and leakage gates pass; explain a failed model and whether ML adds value

stages.name: Deep learning and a small language model
stages.objective: Implement differentiation, attention and a trainable transformer.

modules.name: Tensors and autograd
modules.build: Build scalar autograd engine and a small tensor computation graph
modules.acceptance: Finite-difference gradients match within declared tolerance on well-conditioned float64 examples

modules.name: MLP and backpropagation
modules.build: Implement two-layer network in NumPy then reproduce in PyTorch
modules.acceptance: Derive gradients; overfit tiny batch; identify deliberately broken gradient

modules.name: Training discipline
modules.build: Implement seeds, checkpointing, learning-rate schedules and regularization
modules.acceptance: Resume training; compare controlled runs; separate optimization failure from overfitting

modules.name: CNNs
modules.build: Implement a convolution reference and train small image classifier
modules.acceptance: Compare operator to framework; report held-out accuracy and translation limitations

modules.name: Sequences and representations
modules.build: Implement recurrent cell and compare sequence baseline plus embeddings
modules.acceptance: Handle padding/masks; explain vanishing gradients and representation geometry

modules.name: Tokenizer and data
modules.build: Implement small BPE tokenizer and licensed text split pipeline
modules.acceptance: Round-trip tests pass; train/validation documents disjoint; unknown/Unicode behavior documented

modules.name: Attention
modules.build: Implement masked scaled dot-product and multi-head attention
modules.acceptance: Reference parity and future-token leakage tests pass; shapes/complexity explained

modules.name: Transformer
modules.build: Build decoder blocks, normalization, residuals and generation
modules.acceptance: Causal prediction and checkpoint tests pass; compare outputs to reference primitives

modules.name: Small LM training
modules.build: Train tiny decoder; compare bigram baseline and one ablation
modules.acceptance: Validation loss and compute logged; no unsupported frontier-quality claim; explain unsuccessful runs

modules.name: DL release
modules.build: Profile memory/throughput; publish architecture, experiment manifests and oral defense
modules.acceptance: P7 correctness, derivation, reproducibility and compute-accounting gates pass

stages.name: Evidence-grounded AI applications
stages.objective: Engineer evaluated retrieval, constrained tool use and model adaptation.
stages.career: AI application roles; transferable evaluation expertise

modules.name: Evaluation and baseline
modules.build: Define 60-question evidence-grounded search benchmark and lexical baseline
modules.acceptance: Version questions/reference evidence; separate development and locked test queries

modules.name: Retrieval
modules.build: Implement chunking, inverted retrieval and brute-force cosine search before vector index
modules.acceptance: Recall@5 measured; duplicate and stale-source tests pass; explain index trade-offs

modules.name: Grounded answer service
modules.build: Add cited answer generation, abstention and structured output validation
modules.acceptance: Unsupported questions trigger abstention; cited statements trace to retrieved source spans

modules.name: Reliable tool workflows
modules.build: Implement bounded state machine with allowlisted read-only tools
modules.acceptance: Timeout/retry/token limits hold; invalid tool calls and malicious document instructions cannot expand permissions

modules.name: Evaluation hardening
modules.build: Add prompt-injection, stale-source, malformed-output and cost regression suite
modules.acceptance: P8 locked-test report includes human-audited grading and failure taxonomy

modules.name: Fine-tuning and LoRA
modules.build: Compare prompt/retrieval baseline to small LoRA adaptation
modules.acceptance: Training/evaluation contamination checked; trainable parameter count derived; report whether adaptation helps

modules.name: Preference and synthetic data
modules.build: Implement toy DPO objective; audit synthetic labels and feedback bias
modules.acceptance: Correct gradients; distinguish objective from proven safety; synthetic artifacts never silently enter locked evaluation

modules.name: Production reliability
modules.build: Add model routing, caching, budget limits, traces, fallback and privacy-aware logging
modules.acceptance: Rate limits and simulated provider failures recover; cost per successful task and latency reported

modules.name: AI application release
modules.build: Publish system/data/model cards, limitations, evaluation report and demo
modules.acceptance: P8 contract passes; independent reviewer audits ten answers and one failure; no hidden agent privileges

stages.name: Serving and distributed ML systems
stages.objective: Measure and improve inference/training infrastructure with correctness gates.
stages.career: ML systems/inference entry portfolio plus prior production experience

modules.name: Serving baseline
modules.build: Build request/load generator and instrument a small-model inference endpoint
modules.acceptance: Record time-to-first-token, inter-token latency, throughput, concurrency and memory under fixed workload

modules.name: Batching and scheduling
modules.build: Implement bounded queue and simple batch scheduler
modules.acceptance: Cancellation/backpressure/fairness tests pass; plot throughput versus tail latency

modules.name: KV cache
modules.build: Implement small KV cache or simulator and compare cached/uncached decoding
modules.acceptance: Logits agree within declared tolerance; memory growth versus sequence length measured

modules.name: Quantization
modules.build: Compare supported low-precision configurations to full-precision baseline
modules.acceptance: Quality delta and memory/latency reported; regressions block release

modules.name: Serving engine comparison
modules.build: Run compatible engine such as vLLM on fixed supported hardware/model
modules.acceptance: Baseline and engine share workload/precision; report warmup and reproducibility details

modules.name: Distributed data
modules.build: Implement partitioned deterministic preprocessing with idempotent outputs
modules.acceptance: Worker failure/replay tests pass; single/multiple-worker outputs agree

modules.name: Distributed training
modules.build: Implement synchronous gradient aggregation reference then PyTorch DDP
modules.acceptance: Two CPU processes establish semantics; compare gradients to serial effective batch; explain sampler behavior

modules.name: Checkpoint and recovery
modules.build: Add atomic checkpoint metadata, resume and simulated worker failure
modules.acceptance: State restored without silent corruption; distinguish reproducible state from bitwise nondeterminism

modules.name: Profiling and capacity
modules.build: Profile compute, memory and communication; estimate bottleneck and cost per successful request
modules.acceptance: Evidence supports optimization decision; scaling efficiency and hardware limits reported

modules.name: Systems release
modules.build: Run controlled benchmark, outage drill and design review
modules.acceptance: P9 contract passes; present correctness/performance trade-off and production gaps

stages.name: Distributed infrastructure specialization
stages.objective: Deepen reliability, storage and orchestration through failure-tested systems.

modules.name: Consistency model
modules.build: Specify queue/store guarantees and failure model
modules.acceptance: State linearizability versus eventual-consistency expectations and forbidden histories

modules.name: Replication
modules.build: Implement local replicated log simulator
modules.acceptance: Replica replay yields matching state across reorder/delay scenarios

modules.name: Consensus fundamentals
modules.build: Implement educational election/log-replication subset
modules.acceptance: Partition tests show no conflicting committed entries under stated assumptions; label incomplete Raft scope

modules.name: Durable queue
modules.build: Implement leases, retries and idempotent commits
modules.acceptance: Duplicate delivery tolerated; poison messages quarantined; bounded retry behavior

modules.name: Storage internals
modules.build: Build page/index or LSM-style toy component
modules.acceptance: Compare indexed scan costs; explain WAL/recovery and compaction trade-offs

modules.name: Cloud primitives
modules.build: Deploy isolated staging with IAM, networking and object storage or local equivalents
modules.acceptance: Least-privilege policy and teardown plan tested; distinguish simulation from provider experience

modules.name: Kubernetes
modules.build: Deploy same service to local cluster with resource limits and probes
modules.acceptance: Rolling restart preserves stated service guarantees; rollback tested

modules.name: Scheduling
modules.build: Add fair scheduling, quotas and load shedding
modules.acceptance: Overload does not create unbounded queue or starve one tenant

modules.name: Observability
modules.build: Trace job through API, broker and workers
modules.acceptance: Diagnose one unknown injected failure from telemetry

modules.name: Reliability
modules.build: Exercise backup, restore, zonal-failure simulation and capacity reduction
modules.acceptance: State RPO/RTO, measure recovery, write blameless postmortem

modules.name: Contribution
modules.build: Submit reproducible bug report or focused improvement to an existing infrastructure project
modules.acceptance: Maintainer-readable test and rationale; acceptance not required for completion

modules.name: Infrastructure defense
modules.build: Publish workload/chaos results and design review
modules.acceptance: P10 gate and independent review pass; distinguish local fault simulation from fleet operations

stages.name: GPU and performance engineering
stages.objective: Build correct accelerator kernels and explain measured bottlenecks.

modules.name: C++ foundations
modules.build: Implement owned arrays, templates and RAII wrappers
modules.acceptance: Explain lifetimes/moves; sanitizers and warning checks pass

modules.name: C++ interfaces
modules.build: Build benchmark harness and small numerical library
modules.acceptance: Independent oracle and API invariants tested

modules.name: CPU performance
modules.build: Measure cache locality, vectorization and allocation costs
modules.acceptance: Compiler output and profiles support conclusions

modules.name: GPU architecture
modules.build: Model grids, warps, memory spaces and occupancy
modules.acceptance: Explain bandwidth versus compute bound examples

modules.name: CUDA vector operations
modules.build: Implement vector add and reductions
modules.acceptance: Boundary/nonmultiple-size tests pass; compare CPU oracle

modules.name: CUDA memory
modules.build: Compare coalesced and strided access patterns
modules.acceptance: Bandwidth measured with warmup/synchronization and identical data

modules.name: CUDA matrix multiply
modules.build: Implement naive then tiled matrix multiply
modules.acceptance: Tolerance-based correctness across shape sweep; explain shared-memory design

modules.name: Numerical precision
modules.build: Evaluate FP32 and supported lower precision
modules.acceptance: Worst-case error and downstream quality recorded

modules.name: Triton basics
modules.build: Implement vector add and fused softmax independently
modules.acceptance: Match references across awkward shapes; explain masking

modules.name: Kernel fusion
modules.build: Fuse normalization or bias/activation operations
modules.acceptance: Demonstrate removed memory traffic; report cases slower than library

modules.name: Triton matmul
modules.build: Implement and tune tiled multiplication
modules.acceptance: Publish shape-dependent performance versus optimized library

modules.name: Profiling
modules.build: Use supported GPU profiler to identify stalls and occupancy limits
modules.acceptance: One bottleneck prediction verified or falsified by trace

modules.name: Autotuning
modules.build: Select kernel configurations without test-workload leakage
modules.acceptance: Separate tuning/evaluation shape sets; include tuning overhead

modules.name: Integration
modules.build: Replace one small-model operation with custom kernel
modules.acceptance: Model outputs and quality stay within predeclared tolerance

modules.name: Contribution
modules.build: Prepare targeted performance fix or benchmark for existing project
modules.acceptance: Minimal reproduction and correctness oracle accompany proposed change

modules.name: GPU defense
modules.build: Publish kernel suite and performance report
modules.acceptance: P11 gate passes; no claim of general speedup from one favorable shape

stages.name: Research engineering specialization
stages.objective: Reproduce a bounded research claim and make one controlled extension.

modules.name: Paper selection
modules.build: Choose small LoRA or optimization result with accessible code/data
modules.acceptance: Claim, dependencies and compute feasibility approved in written protocol

modules.name: Literature map
modules.build: Read target plus two closely related papers
modules.acceptance: Distinguish established evidence, author claims and open questions

modules.name: Protocol
modules.build: Predeclare metrics, split, seeds, compute cap and deviation rules
modules.acceptance: Replication target and failure criteria unambiguous

modules.name: Baseline implementation
modules.build: Implement relevant baseline and parity tests
modules.acceptance: Baseline behavior agrees with published or official reference within scoped expectations

modules.name: Method implementation
modules.build: Implement target modification from equations
modules.acceptance: Equation-to-code trace and independent correctness checks pass

modules.name: Pilot
modules.build: Run miniature end-to-end experiment and profile cost
modules.acceptance: Projected full experiment fits cap or rescope before launch

modules.name: Replication
modules.build: Execute fixed runs and preserve raw logs
modules.acceptance: Failed runs retained; seed/config/code/data identifiers complete

modules.name: Statistical analysis
modules.build: Estimate uncertainty with appropriate unit of resampling
modules.acceptance: Do not treat dependent examples/seeds as independent evidence

modules.name: Ablations
modules.build: Run two focused ablations within budget
modules.acceptance: Only intended variable changes; negative results retained

modules.name: Extension
modules.build: Test one justified hypothesis at equal budget
modules.acceptance: Label exploratory analysis and avoid post-hoc success criteria

modules.name: External feedback
modules.build: Request technical critique and prepare contribution
modules.acceptance: Reviewer can reproduce a subset; deviations documented

modules.name: Research defense
modules.build: Release reproducibility package and paper-style report
modules.acceptance: P12 gate passes; describe scaled reproduction limits and unsupported generalization

stages.career: AI compiler roles; optional after GPU competence

modules.build: Specify typed expression language and interpreter
modules.acceptance: Reference semantics handle shape/type errors explicitly

modules.name: Lexer and parser
modules.build: Build lexer, parser and AST
modules.acceptance: Malformed/ambiguous expressions covered by tests

modules.name: Type checking
modules.build: Implement scalar/tensor type and shape checks
modules.acceptance: Invalid programs fail before execution

modules.name: IR generation
modules.build: Lower expressions to LLVM IR
modules.acceptance: Compiled output matches interpreter on generated cases

modules.name: Control flow
modules.build: Add branches and loops
modules.acceptance: Control-flow graphs and execution agree on boundary cases

modules.name: Optimization basics
modules.build: Implement constant folding and dead-code elimination
modules.acceptance: Differential tests preserve semantics

modules.name: Numerical legality
modules.build: Explore reassociation and floating-point constraints
modules.acceptance: Document where mathematically equivalent rewrites alter numeric results

modules.name: JIT integration
modules.build: Expose compiled functions to Python benchmark
modules.acceptance: Compile time separated from execution time

modules.name: Tensor lowering
modules.build: Implement restricted tensor-operation lowering
modules.acceptance: Shape/stride correctness verified; unsupported cases rejected

modules.name: Performance study
modules.build: Compare generated kernels to interpreter and library
modules.acceptance: Report compile overhead and break-even workload

modules.name: Contribution
modules.build: Prepare focused compiler test/bugfix for external project
modules.acceptance: Minimal IR reproducer and explanation included

modules.name: Compiler defense
modules.build: Release compiler demo and correctness/performance report
modules.acceptance: P13 gate passes; explain limitations versus production compiler stack

resources.title: MIT Mathematics for CS

resources.title: PostgreSQL Tutorial

resources.title: FastAPI Tutorial

resources.title: Docker Get Started

resources.title: OWASP Top Ten

resources.title: OSTEP

resources.title: CMU Computer Systems

resources.title: Stanford CS144
resources.scope: Datagrams, reliability, TCP, congestion control. Use notes for an original socket lab; do not publish restricted course solutions.

resources.title: Nand2Tetris
resources.scope: Projects 1–5 concepts: gates, arithmetic, memory, machine language and CPU; implement a small ALU and inspect instruction execution, not the entire course.

resources.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning

resources.title: MIT Linear Algebra
resources.scope: Elimination, vector spaces, orthogonality, least squares, eigenvalues and SVD. Replace corresponding R15 explanations if unclear; do not take both in full.

resources.title: scikit-learn User Guide
resources.scope: Linear models, trees/ensembles, clustering, preprocessing, pipelines, cross-validation, metrics, calibration and common pitfalls.

resources.title: PyTorch Learn the Basics
resources.scope: Tensors, datasets/loaders, transforms, model building, autograd, optimization, saving/loading.

resources.title: Dive into Deep Learning
resources.scope: Linear regression, softmax regression, MLPs, numerical stability, CNNs, RNNs, attention, transformers, optimization; use PyTorch version, selected sections only.

resources.title: Hugging Face LLM Course
resources.scope: Chapters 1–3 for models/fine-tuning, 5–6 for datasets/tokenizers; inspect applicable model/dataset licenses. Advanced fine-tuning only after baseline evaluation.

resources.title: Full Stack Deep Learning 2022
resources.scope: Development infrastructure, data management, testing, deployment, continual learning, ethics; concepts are durable, old tool commands need current docs.

resources.title: Stanford CS336
resources.scope: Basics assignment: tokenizer/model/optimizer; systems and scaling lecture topics; data and alignment readings. Our small projects are scoped alternatives, not a claim to complete the course.

resources.title: MIT Distributed Systems
resources.scope: MapReduce, fault tolerance, Raft, consistency and storage; selected readings plus original projects. Full course labs are optional replacements with new time estimates.

resources.title: Google SRE book
resources.scope: Service Level Objectives; Monitoring Distributed Systems; Emergency Response; Managing Incidents; Postmortem Culture; Addressing Cascading Failures.

resources.title: PyTorch DDP

resources.title: vLLM Documentation

resources.title: Kubernetes Basics

resources.title: C++ Core Guidelines
resources.scope: Interfaces, resource management, memory, concurrency and performance; use as code-review rules, not a beginner course.

resources.title: CUDA Programming Guide

resources.scope: Scaled dot-product attention, multi-head attention, positional information, masking, optimization; implement a decoder-only adaptation and explain the architectural difference.

resources.title: LoRA paper
resources.scope: Low-rank update equations, parameter count and experimental controls; small reproduction only.

resources.title: DPO paper
resources.scope: Preference objective and implicit reward relationship; compute toy loss/gradient and examine preference-data limitations.
